people.line: Mutanen da su ma ke amfani da {name}, waɗanda kake aika musu ɗawainiyoyi da abubuwan da aka ƙirƙira a {name}, kuma suke mayar maka da amsoshinsu. Su kaɗai ke iya buɗe abin da ka aika musu.
people.side: Nuna lambar da za a duba
people.qr: Gayyatar a matsayin lambar QR, don kyamarar wayarsu
people.point: Za su nuna kyamarar wayarsu ga lambar, ko su buɗe hanyar haɗin. Tana aiki muddin wannan yana buɗe.
people.week: Aika ta yadda kake aika musu komai. Tana aiki har mako ɗaya.
people.typeCode: Lambobi shida da {name} ke nuna maka ko ke mayar maka

people.wrong.one: Waɗannan lambobin ba su dace ba. Gwaji {count} ya rage.
people.wrong.other: Waɗannan lambobin ba su dace ba. Gwaje-gwaje {count} sun rage.

people.added: An ƙara {name} cikin mutanenka. Da zarar sun amsa, za ku iya aika wa juna ɗawainiyoyi.
people.accepted: An karɓi gayyatarka ta {name}. Rubuta lambobi shida da aka mayar maka.
people.remove: A cire {name}? Abin da suka aiko maka zai ci gaba da zama naka.
people.invited: Ana gayyatarka don ku riƙa aika wa juna ɗawainiyoyi ta {name}.
people.from: Daga wurin wa wannan ya zo?
people.seen: Za su ga sunan da wannan bayanin martaba ke amfani da shi.
people.showCode: Nuna waɗannan lambobin ga mutumin da ke gefenka, ko ka mayar musu da su ta hanyar da gayyatar ta zo
people.metThem: An ƙara {name} cikin mutanenka. Za ku iya aika wa juna ɗawainiyoyi.
people.reading: Tare da abin da aka karanta
people.size: {size}, daga cikin {limit} da za a iya aikawa a lokaci ɗaya
people.measuring: Ana duba abin da zai tafi…
people.opens: Suna da mako ɗaya don su buɗe shi.
people.why.waiting: Ba su amsa ba tukuna. Da zarar sun amsa, za ka iya aika musu abubuwa.
people.why.large: Wannan ya yi girma da yawa don aikawa. Ba tare da abin da aka karanta ba, ko wani sashe nasa, zai iya dacewa.
people.why.unreached: Wannan bai isa gare su ba. Duba haɗin ka sake gwadawa.
people.why.link: Wannan ba hanyar haɗin gayyata ba ce. Sake nemanta.
people.why.used: An riga an yi amfani da wannan gayyatar. Nemi sabuwa.
people.why.gone: An dakatar da wannan gayyatar ko lokacinta ya ƙare. Nemi sabuwa.
people.why.self: Wannan gayyatarka ce. Aika ta ga ɗayan mutumin.
people.why.known: Wannan mutumin yana cikin mutanenka tuni.
people.why.tries: Gwaje-gwaje uku marasa daidai: an dakatar da gayyatar, don tsaro. Sake farawa.
people.why.relay: Ba za a iya kai wa wurin ba a yanzu. Duba haɗin ka sake gwadawa.
people.why.child: Bayanin martabar yaro ba ya ƙara mutane.
people.why.broken: Wani abu ya ɓaci. Sake gwadawa.
